import json, os, time
from aws_cli import call, observe
env = dict(os.environ, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION='us-west-2', AWS_REGION='us-west-2', AWS_PAGER='')
identity = call('sts', 'get-caller-identity', env=env)
assert identity['Account'] == '000000000000'
expressions = {'pad-direct': "$length($pad('',262145,'x'))", 'pad-concat': "$length($pad('',131072,'x') & $pad('',131073,'x'))", 'pad-existing': "$length($pad($pad('',131072,'x'),262145,'x'))", 'join': "$length($join([$pad('',131072,'x'),$pad('',131073,'x')]))", 'pad-unicode': "$length($pad('',262144,'é'))", 'pad-pattern': "$length($pad('',262144,'xy'))"}
observations = []
for label, expression in expressions.items():
    parameters = {'definition': json.dumps({'Type':'Pass','QueryLanguage':'JSONata','Output':'{% '+expression+' %}','End':True}, separators=(',', ':')), 'input':'{}', 'inspectionLevel':'INFO'}
    started = int(time.time()*1000)
    result = observe('stepfunctions', 'test-state', parameters, env=env)
    observations.append({'label':label, 'service':'stepfunctions', 'operation':'test-state', 'input':parameters, 'request_started_ms':started, 'result':result})
